metadata.name: slana
metadata.description: Slana: cute coin-themed on-chain Agar.io (identity and stakes)

instructions.name: create_arena
docs: Fails with `TokenNotSet` until `set_token_mint` ran.

accounts.name: config
docs: Arenas need the game token: `TokenNotSet` until `set_token_mint` ran.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The arena's token vault: holds every entry fee, signed for by the arena PDA.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the config (no token yet). Only the program's upgrade authority may call it.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority (prevents front-running `initialize`).

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData account (PDA of the upgradeable loader, seeds `[program_id]`).

instructions.name: join_arena
docs: Pays the entry fee into the arena vault and opens a session. Fails with `TokenNotSet`
before the mint is set, with `FeeAboveLimit` if the fee rate fixed into the session
exceeds `max_fee_bps` (the rate the player was shown), with `EntryFeeAboveLimit` if the
arena's entry fee exceeds `max_entry_fee`, and with `SettleFeeAboveLimit` if the settle
deposit exceeds `max_settle_fee`.

accounts.name: config
docs: `TokenNotSet` until `set_token_mint` ran.

accounts.name: session
docs: One open session per player per arena: a second join fails because the PDA exists
(also while a finalized session waits for its payout to be collected).

instructions.name: refund_session
docs: Player-signed. A finalized session pays its `owed` payout at once; an unsettled one
returns the entry fee after `SESSION_REFUND_TIMEOUT_SECS`.

instructions.name: set_token_mint
docs: Sets the game token, once, while it is unset (`TokenAlreadySet` afterwards).

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The game token. Validated by `token::validate_mint` (no freeze authority, no
forbidden Token-2022 extension) and stored in the config for good.

instructions.name: settle_session
docs: Server-signed settlement of a stake session (a death, the round bell, or an operator
exit). The fee on profit goes to the fee wallet's token account. With the player's
token account the payout is paid and the session closed; without it
(`player_token = None`) the session is finalized with `owed` for the player to collect
via `refund_session` (R24).

accounts.name: server
docs: Receives the session's settle deposit.

accounts.name: session
docs: Closed back to the player when the payout is paid in this transaction; kept open
(finalized, with `owed`) when `player_token` is absent.

accounts.name: player_token
docs: Any token account of the game mint owned by the player (the player creates and pays
for it; the server never does). Optional (R24): without it, or when the player
made it unable to receive, the server settles anyway and the session is finalized with
`owed`, which the player collects with `refund_session`. So a player can delay their
own payout but never block the game result.

accounts.name: fee_wallet_token
docs: Receives the fee: any token account of the game mint owned by `config.fee_wallet`
(not necessarily its associated token account). Required even when the fee is 0.

instructions.name: sweep_arena
docs: Admin: moves the whole vault of a disabled arena with no open session to the fee
wallet's token account.

accounts.name: fee_wallet_token
docs: Any token account of the game mint owned by `config.fee_wallet`.

instructions.name: sweep_loot
docs: Server-signed: burns `amount` (at most the vault balance) of an arena vault's floor
loot, while the arena runs. `amount == 0` succeeds and does nothing.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: Writable: the burn lowers its supply.

types.name: Arena
docs: A stake arena tier. PDA `["arena", id.to_le_bytes()]`.
Entry fees are held in the arena's token vault `["vault", arena]` (authority = this PDA).

fields.name: entry_fee
docs: Entry fee in base units of the game token.

fields.name: max_sessions
docs: Maximum number of simultaneously open sessions.

fields.name: vault
docs: The arena's token vault.

types.name: ArenaSwept
docs: `sweep_arena` moved `amount` from the arena vault to the fee wallet's token account.

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration. PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: May change the configuration, set the token mint, and create and sweep arenas.

fields.name: server_authority
docs: Game server key that signs `settle_session` and `sweep_loot`.

fields.name: fee_wallet
docs: Owner of the token account that receives every fee and every swept arena vault.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The game token ($SLANA); `Pubkey::default()` until `set_token_mint`, then fixed.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Token program owning `token_mint` (SPL Token or Token-2022); default while unset.

fields.name: token_decimals
docs: Decimals of `token_mint` (0 while unset).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee charged on stake profit, in basis points (≤ `MAX_FEE_BPS`).

fields.name: settle_fee_lamports
docs: Lamports a player deposits per session to pay the server's settle transaction
(≤ `MAX_SETTLE_FEE_LAMPORTS`).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new arena joins (settlements and refunds keep working).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee on stake profit in basis points (≤ `MAX_FEE_BPS`).

fields.name: settle_fee_lamports
docs: Settle deposit per session in lamports (≤ `MAX_SETTLE_FEE_LAMPORTS`).

fields.name: server_authority
docs: Game server key (not the default key).

fields.name: fee_wallet
docs: Owner of the token account that receives the fees (not the default key).

types.name: LootBurned
docs: `sweep_loot` burned `amount` from the arena vault.

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: On-chain player identity and statistics. PDA `["profile", owner]`.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 name bytes, zero padded; only `name[..name_len]` is meaningful.

fields.name: skin
docs: Equipped skin id (`< BASIC_SKINS`).

types.name: Session
docs: An open stake session (one per player per arena). PDA `["session", arena, player]`.
Its lamport balance is its rent plus `settle_fee`, both paid by the player at join: the
deposit goes to the server at settlement (it pays the settle transaction), the rent back to
the player. A refund returns both to the player.

fields.name: id
docs: `Config::total_sessions` at join (PDAs are reused, ids are not).

fields.name: entry_fee
docs: Entry fee paid into the arena vault, in base units of the game token.

fields.name: settle_fee
docs: Settle deposit in lamports (`Config::settle_fee_lamports` at join).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee on profit in basis points, fixed at join (`Config::fee_bps`): later fee changes
never touch an open session.

fields.name: finalized
docs: Settled without a player token account (R24): the game result is final and the
fee is paid, but `owed` still sits in the arena vault until the player collects it with
`refund_session` (no waiting time). The session stays open (it counts in
`Arena::open_sessions`, so the vault cannot be swept meanwhile).

fields.name: owed
docs: Game tokens the player is owed by a finalized session (0 otherwise).

fields.name: finalized
docs: The session was finalized: `amount` is its owed payout, not an entry-fee refund.

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee on profit, paid to the fee wallet's token account.

fields.name: owed
docs: Player share left in the vault for the player to collect (finalized without a token
account); 0 when it was paid in the same transaction.

fields.name: session_id
docs: `Session::id` the server is settling. Session PDAs are reused when a player joins
the same arena again, so this stops a delayed/retried settlement of an old session
from being applied to a newer one at the same address.

fields.name: payout
docs: Game-token base units the player cashed out with (taken from the arena vault, before
the fee on profit).

types.name: TokenMintSet
docs: `set_token_mint` stored the game token.

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Every `Some` field replaces the stored value; `None` keeps it. The token mint is set
with `set_token_mint` and cannot be changed here.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: ≤ `MAX_FEE_BPS`. Open sessions keep the rate fixed at their join.

constants.name: ARENA_SEED
docs: `Arena` PDA: `["arena", id.to_le_bytes() (u16)]`.

constants.name: BASIC_SKINS
docs: Number of basic skins (ids `0..BASIC_SKINS`); every player may use all of them.

constants.name: BPS
docs: Basis-point denominator (100 %).

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: `Config` PDA: `["config"]`.

constants.name: MAX_ARENA_SESSIONS
docs: Maximum value of `Arena::max_sessions`.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Upper bound for `Config::fee_bps` (10 %).

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LEN
docs: Maximum player name length in bytes (UTF-8).

constants.name: MAX_SCORE_PER_GAME
docs: Score of a single game is clamped to this value.

constants.name: MAX_SETTLE_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: Upper bound for `Config::settle_fee_lamports` (the per-session settle deposit).

constants.name: MAX_XP_PER_GAME
docs: XP granted by a single game is clamped to this value.

constants.name: MIN_ARENA_SESSIONS
docs: Minimum value of `Arena::max_sessions`.

constants.name: PROFILE_SEED
docs: `PlayerProfile` PDA: `["profile", owner]`.

constants.name: SESSION_REFUND_TIMEOUT_SECS
docs: A session that was never settled can be refunded by its player after this many seconds (24 h).

constants.name: SESSION_SEED
docs: `Session` PDA: `["session", arena, player]`.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Token vault of an arena (authority = the arena PDA): `["vault", arena]`.

constants.name: XP_LEVEL_DIVISOR
docs: `level = 1 + isqrt(xp / XP_LEVEL_DIVISOR)`.
